_readme: One entry per public register. Download each list to registries/raw/ (git-ignored), fill 'file' and 'as_of' with the date printed on the list, then run: python -m lender_engine sources --inspect (to see what the parser reads) and python -m lender_engine sources (to build the pool). 'include': true puts the register's rows in the enrichment pool; false keeps them in registry_pool_full.csv only. BSP registers are downloaded with scripts/fetch_bsp_directory.py. Formats: pdf, xlsx, csv, or extract (a hand-made CSV with columns name,registry_id,hq,extra). URLs and dates below were last checked on 2026-09-17 and must be re-checked on the day the pool is built.

registers.source: BSP Directory of Banks and Non-Bank Financial Institutions: digital banks
registers.notes: Downloaded 2026-09-17 with scripts/fetch_bsp_directory.py from the REST feed behind the public page https://www.bsp.gov.ph/SitePages/FinancialStability/DirBanksFIList.aspx (SharePoint list 'Institutions', filtered on InstitutionTypeID 14; type codes from the 'Financial Institution' list). The page prints 'Updated as of' the newest Modified timestamp of the list in Manila time; the newest was 2026-09-14T08:15:29Z, so as_of is 2026-09-14. The feed also carries the name, e-mail, phone and fax of each institution's head; those fields are not requested by the script and are not in the raw file. The Status column (2 or empty) is not documented on the page and is not used. registry_id is the BSP InstitutionID, a row identifier in the directory, not a licence number. Seven rows: the six banks licensed in 2021-2022 plus Maribank Philippines, Inc.

registers.source: BSP Directory of Banks and Non-Bank Financial Institutions: rural and cooperative banks
registers.notes: Downloaded 2026-09-17 with scripts/fetch_bsp_directory.py from the REST feed behind the public page https://www.bsp.gov.ph/SitePages/FinancialStability/DirBanksFIList.aspx (SharePoint list 'Institutions', filtered on InstitutionTypeID 11; type codes from the 'Financial Institution' list). The page prints 'Updated as of' the newest Modified timestamp of the list in Manila time; the newest was 2026-09-14T08:15:29Z, so as_of is 2026-09-14. The feed also carries the name, e-mail, phone and fax of each institution's head; those fields are not requested by the script and are not in the raw file. The Status column (2 or empty) is not documented on the page and is not used. registry_id is the BSP InstitutionID, a row identifier in the directory, not a licence number. 366 rows (rural banks, InstitutionTypeID2 12, and cooperative banks, InstitutionTypeID2 13). Full pool only; to enrich a subset, build a hand-made extract of that subset and add it as a separate register with include=true.

registers.source: SEC list of recorded online lending platforms
registers.notes: Read on 2026-09-17 from the HTML table on the page (the SEC publishes this list as a page, not a file). The page heading reads: 'List of Financing and Lending Companies Recorded with the SEC and their Online Lending Platforms as reported pursuant to SEC MC 20, series of 2026 as of 14 September 2026'. sec.gov.ph blocks scripted downloads, so the table was captured from the rendered page in a normal Chrome session (see scripts/sec_tables_to_csv.py) and converted to CSV without edits. registry_id is the SEC registration number printed in the 'SEC Number' column; the certificate of authority number is not on this list. The 'extra' column carries the platform names as printed. These lenders already take applications online, so the document-based underwriting pain is the most visible here.

registers.source: SEC list of financing companies with certificate of authority (RA 8556)
registers.notes: Downloaded 2026-09-17 in a normal Chrome session (sec.gov.ph blocks scripted downloads). The PDF is titled 'LIST OF FINANCING COMPANIES AS OF 30 SEPTEMBER 2023'. It is the most recent list with certificate of authority found on sec.gov.ph: the pages linked from the site's lending and financing section (list-of-lending-companies/ and list-of-lending-companies-3/) still show the 31 May 2020 lists, and this 2023 file was located through a web search and confirmed to be served by sec.gov.ph. The page that links it was not found. Columns on the list: company name, SEC registration no., cert. of authority no., date of registration; registry_id is the CA number. Around 700 entities. Full pool only by default; Kita's team is the right judge of which financing companies are worth enriching. Rows repeating the title on each page are dropped by drop_regex.

registers.source: SEC list of revoked and suspended lending and financing companies
registers.notes: Read on 2026-09-17 from the six HTML tables on the page: revoked lending company CA (56 rows), revoked financing company CA (75), suspended lending company CA (30), revoked primary registration (414), revoked lending companies organised as partnerships (835), and lending or financing companies with cease and desist orders (3). The page prints no as-of date; each row carries its own revocation date in the raw CSV. Captured from the rendered page in a normal Chrome session (see scripts/sec_tables_to_csv.py) and converted without edits. The 'extra' column names the list a row came from. Not a prospect list: a gate. Any name in the enrichment pool that also appears here should get closeability near 0.1 (see the closeability rubric). Cross-checking is done by the enrichment prompt from public data today; a hard join on this extract is a small next step.
